'''Rotworms''' were a type of [[Worm/Legends|worm]]. Following the [[Third Battle of Vontor]], [[Kossak Inijic Ar'durv]] taunted that [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] would only be able to conquer rotworms in his dungeon from then on. They also were present on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].
